name: outer_frames
summary: Which frames are outer frames: a face on a cell of the planet's outside air. Each with its exposed faces, airtightness, build state and colour; nearest first, 20 per page. Read only.

help.text: Each frame: reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, position, distance_m, exposed_faces (+z north, +y up), exposed_face_count, blocks_air (its build state is airtight), build_state (0 bare up to the prefab's finished state; a finished steel frame is 3) and color. Also count, total_frames, total_outer, paging and local_player. include_inner lists every frame.

exposed.summary: When a face counts as exposed.
exposed.text: The 2 m cell across the face is in no room (rooms are closed spaces of up to 1200 cells, walled by anything that blocks walking), can hold air (no airtight structure in it, not buried in terrain), is open to the frame through the shared face, and, when it holds a one-sheet frame, its air passes the game's storm exposure test (within 1 kPa of the planet's). A sealed space over 1200 cells has no room, so frames facing into it count as outer; a space closed only by one-sheet frames is a room, so its faces do not count though it leaks.

near_player_m.description: Only frames within this many metres of the player.

include_inner.description: List every frame; inner ones have no exposed faces. Default false.

x-paging.order: nearest the player first, then reference id
